name: Bull AI
description:
Bull AI gives Claude access to company documents and data for NSE/BSE-listed Indian companies. 

Search companies by name, symbol, or ISIN; read filings, annual reports, transcripts, and presentations; and get classifications, peers, corporate actions, and management guidance with source citations. Documents are parsed for search and retrieval. 

Sign in with OAuth; usage is subject to existing Bull AI account limits. Results are not trading instructions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bull AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bull AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.bull-ai.in/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bull AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bull AI provides these MCP tools: get_company_classification, get_company_corporate_actions, get_company_counterparties, get_company_guidance, get_company_market_transactions, get_company_peers, get_document_chunks, list_document_availability, search_companies, and search_company_documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bull AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bull AI in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Bull AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bull AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bull AI is developed by Bull AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
